quests.name: The Unnamed Champion
quests.offer:
An unnamed champion has driven everyone off the plateau. To name him we need blood, resilan and garlic together.
Will you bring them?
quests.declined: The plateau will wait, for now.
quests.started: A vial of bolash blood from the bats on the plateau, the Elem Kabar Resilan, and your garlic trinket.

steps.journal: Bring Lerod Damonus a blood vial from the bolash bats of Zaoran Plateau, the Elem Kabar Resilan and your garlic trinket.
steps.says: Good. Salin in Highbourne knows what they are for. Go to him.
steps.reminder: The blood vial, the resilan and the trinket, all three.

steps.says: There is a scroll. Torgias in Murnf has it. Bring it here.

steps.journal: Get the scroll from Torgias Bullow in Murnf.
steps.says: This? Take it. Nobody here can read it.

steps.journal: Take the scroll back to Salin in Highbourne, with the vial, the resilan and the trinket.
steps.says: I can read it, but for one symbol. The Council may know it. I keep the vial, the resilan and your trinket: they are what it asks for.
steps.reminder: The scroll, and the other three.

steps.journal: Take the last symbol to the Council of Watchmen in Dshinn's Redoubt.
steps.says: Razeal. Razeal Moloch. He walks the castle by the plateau's port-in. Summon him, and destroy him.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## The Unnamed Champion (Razeal Moloch) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's 'Council member' is Lerod Damonus (ours: it names none); its 'Salin in Highbourne' and 'Torgias in Murnf' are the game's Salin and Torgias Bullow. No reward but what he drops.

quests.name: Destroy Razeal
quests.offer:
He looks through you. Something near the Wailing Ghost has begun to stir.
Do you name him?
quests.started: He is gone, and a gravestone rises by the Wailing Ghost.

events.text: He is gone. Four graves will call him, near the Wailing Ghost: a tank, a healer, a caster and a melee must speak, one at each, in turn. Then a post, and a way to his isle. Twenty minutes, once you stand there.

steps.journal: Teleport your group to Razeal and destroy him!

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## The Unnamed Champion (Razeal Moloch) (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 3 to 5. Repeatable, as the guide's 'each time you want to kill, you just need to walk up to Razeal'. The guide's teleporter is a portal by the post; the zp armour gems he drops wait on the ZP armour, not built.
